setupAdmin.title: Create the first administrator
setupAdmin.subtitle: No administrator exists yet for this activation. Create the first administrator account of your organisation.

username.label: Username
username.hint: Do not use "admin": that username is reserved for the system account created on first start.

password.label: Password
password.hint: At least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.

setupAdmin.resetHint: Wrong activation? Clear the local licence data and enter another key.

join.title: Joining your plant… (synchronising)
join.body: This PC is receiving your organisation's accounts from the server. If your plant already has administrators, you will sign in with your account; otherwise you will create the first administrator.
join.connectionTitle: A connection is needed to join your plant
join.connectionBody: This PC could not synchronise with the server. Your plant may already have accounts: the first administrator can be created only once the server has confirmed that it has none. Check the network connection, then retry.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to access Maintafox

activationRequired.title: Product activation required
activationRequired.message: Activate this device with your organization license key before signing in.

login.postActivationHint: Please contact your Administrator for account credentials.

firstAdmin.title: No administrator on this PC yet
firstAdmin.message: This PC is activated but its first administrator has not been created. Create it now; you will then sign in with that account.

tenantScopeDenied.title: Account not authorized for activated tenant
tenantScopeDenied.action: Action: use an authorized account for this tenant or reactivate the device with the correct tenant license key.

staleSession.title: Stale session context
staleSession.action: Action: sign in again to refresh tenant claims after an activation change.

resetActivation.confirmBody: The licence data stored on this device is cleared and you return to the activation screen to enter another key. Maintenance data is not deleted.
resetActivation.hint: Wrong tenant or need to enter a new license key? This clears local license data and returns you to product activation.
resetActivation.errorFallback: Could not reset activation. Try again, or restart the app.

error.accountLocked: Account temporarily locked. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.networkRequired: First login on this device requires a network connection.
error.deviceRevoked: This device has been revoked. Online login required.
error.offlineExpired: Offline login window expired. Online login required.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Password recovery
forgotPassword.description: Contact an administrator below. They can set a temporary password so you can sign in and choose a new one.
forgotPassword.empty: No active administrators are available to contact. Speak to someone on site who can help reset your password.
forgotPassword.error: Could not load administrator contacts. Check that the application database is available, then try again.
forgotPassword.noDigitalContact: No email or phone on file — speak to them on site.
forgotPassword.footer: An administrator must reset your password. Self-service email reset is not available.

recoveryCode.title: Vendor recovery code
recoveryCode.description: If this plant has no administrator able to sign in, the Maintafox vendor can issue a one-time code for this PC after checking your identity. It creates one new administrator; existing accounts are not changed.
recoveryCode.usernameHint: A username never used on this PC.
recoveryCode.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
recoveryCode.success: The administrator "{{username}}" has been created. Sign in with this account; the other administrators will be notified.

logout.label: Sign out
logout.confirm: Do you want to sign out?

builtinAdmin.title: Built-in administrator account in use
builtinAdmin.passwordPending: This "admin" account was created by an earlier version of Maintafox. Choose your password, then create a named administrator in Users & Roles and disable this account.
builtinAdmin.passwordChanged: This "admin" account was created by an earlier version of Maintafox and is the only administrator of this PC. Create a named administrator in Users & Roles, then disable this account.
builtinAdmin.otherAdministratorExists: A named administrator exists on this PC: disable this "admin" account in Users & Roles.

recoveryNotice.title: Administrator created with a recovery code
recoveryNotice.message: An administrator, {{name}} (username: {{username}}), was created with a vendor recovery code on {{date}} on PC {{device}}.

singleAdministrator.title: Create a second administrator
singleAdministrator.message: You are the only active administrator of this plant. Create a second administrator in Users & Roles: two administrators can reset each other's password, so a forgotten password never shuts the plant out, and a locked account never for more than an hour.

expired.title: Session expired
expired.message: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

idleLocked.title: Session locked
idleLocked.message: Your session is locked due to inactivity.

forcePasswordChange.tooShort: The password must have at least {{min}} characters.
forcePasswordChange.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
forcePasswordChange.hint: At least {{min}} characters; your organisation's password policy applies.
forcePasswordChange.title: Password change required
forcePasswordChange.message: You must set a new password before continuing.

pin.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please use your password.
pin.hint: 4–6 digit PIN. Entry is detected automatically.

session.title: Session interrupted
session.message: For your security, we’ve paused the app. Sign in again to continue without losing your place.

permission.title: Action not permitted
permission.message: Your account can’t perform this action. If you think this is a mistake, sign in again or ask an administrator.

generic.title: Access interrupted
generic.message: We’ve temporarily paused the app. Sign in again to continue safely.

stepUp.title: Identity confirmation required
stepUp.message: This is a sensitive action. Enter your password to confirm.
stepUp.locked_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
stepUp.locked_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.

device.revokeConfirm: Offline access for this device will be removed. Continue?

unauthorized.title: Unauthorized Access
unauthorized.message: You do not have the necessary permissions to access this page.

activation.title: Product activation
activation.subtitle: Enter the license key issued for this organization. We will validate it before activating this device.
activation.verifiedTitle: Your license has been successfully verified.
activation.verifiedBody: You are about to activate this device for:
activation.slotNote: No additional license seat will be consumed until activation completes.

denied.revokedBody: This device license is revoked by operator policy. Contact support with diagnostics.
denied.expiredBody: License validity window has ended. Renewal is required before continuing.
denied.slotBody: No activation slot is available for this machine fingerprint.
denied.forceUpdateBody: Your desktop version is below the forced minimum version policy.
denied.invalidBody: Control plane rejected this activation attempt.
denied.offlineGraceTitle: Connection to the licence server required
denied.offlineGraceBody: This device has been offline longer than your licence allows. Connect it to the internet; access is restored automatically once the licence is confirmed.

activation.offlineWarning: You are offline. Local state is saved and reconciliation will resume when online.

network_unreachable.title: Unable to connect
network_unreachable.message: We could not reach the activation service. Check your network connection and try again.

license_not_found.title: License not found
license_not_found.message: We could not find a valid license for this key. Check the key and try again.

license_revoked.title: License revoked
license_revoked.message: This license has been revoked. Contact your administrator for a new key.

license_expired.title: License expired
license_expired.message: This license is no longer valid. Renewal is required before you can activate.

activation_revoked.title: Device revoked
activation_revoked.message: This device was revoked by the vendor. Ask your administrator to have it reinstated.

tenant_inactive.title: Account deactivated
tenant_inactive.message: Your organization's account is deactivated. Contact your vendor to restore access.

slot_limit_reached.title: Device limit reached
slot_limit_reached.message: All allowed devices for this license are already activated. Ask your administrator to free a seat.

activation_conflict.title: Device limit reached
activation_conflict.message: All allowed devices for this license are already activated. Ask your administrator to free a seat.

force_update_required.title: Update required
force_update_required.message: This device must be updated before activation can continue.

tenant_init_unavailable.title: Activation could not be completed
tenant_init_unavailable.message: The activation server could not finish preparing your organization. Please try again.

tenant_init_failed.title: Activation could not be completed
tenant_init_failed.message: The activation server could not finish preparing your organization. Please try again.

activation.pasteKeyLabel: Paste the license key from the clipboard
activation.keyHint: Use the key supplied by Maintafox or your administrator.

lockout.title: Account Locked
lockout.message: Account temporarily locked. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
lockout.adminUnlock: Contact an administrator to unlock your account.
